			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 4 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_4 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_firearms } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 5 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_5 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_firearms } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 6 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_6 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_firearms } }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count < 6 has_variable = sol_sub_multiplier_horses var:sol_sub_multiplier_horses > 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_count add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 1 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_1 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_horses } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 2 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_2 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_horses } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 3 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_3 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_horses } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 4 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_4 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_horses } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 5 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_5 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_horses } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 6 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_6 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_horses } }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count < 6 has_variable = sol_sub_multiplier_camels var:sol_sub_multiplier_camels > 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_count add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 1 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_1 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_camels } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 2 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_2 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_camels } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 3 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_3 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_camels } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 4 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_4 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_camels } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 5 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_5 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_camels } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 6 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_6 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_camels } }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count < 6 has_variable = sol_sub_multiplier_elephants var:sol_sub_multiplier_elephants > 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_count add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 1 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_1 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_elephants } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 2 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_2 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_elephants } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 3 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_3 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_elephants } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 4 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_4 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_elephants } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 5 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_5 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_elephants } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 6 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_6 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_elephants } }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count < 6 has_variable = sol_sub_multiplier_books var:sol_sub_multiplier_books > 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_count add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 1 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_1 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_books } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 2 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_2 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_books } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 3 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_3 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_books } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 4 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_4 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_books } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 5 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_5 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_books } }
			else_if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_hud_count = 6 } set_variable = { name = sol_sub_hud_good_6 value = flag:SOL_LSHUD_GOOD_ICON_books } }
		}
		remove_local_variable = sol_sub_hud_count
	}
}

sol_refresh_country_substitution = {
	# Scheduled pulse: subtract the cached auto-modifier contribution before solving.
	save_scope_as = sol_sub_country
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sol_market_substitution_initialized } } sol_refresh_market_pop_demand_maps = yes }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_market_missing value = 0 }
	every_market_present_in_country = { save_scope_as = sol_sub_market_probe if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_substitute_cache } NOT = { is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_substitute_cache target = scope:sol_sub_market_probe } } } } scope:sol_sub_country = { set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_market_missing value = 1 } } } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_market_missing = 1 } sol_refresh_market_pop_demand_maps = yes }
	remove_local_variable = sol_sub_market_missing

	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_size_weaponry = 0 } remove_variable = sol_sub_size_weaponry }
	remove_variable = sol_sub_base_weaponry
	remove_variable = sol_sub_target_weaponry
	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_base_wheat > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_sub_multiplier_wheat value = { value = var:sol_sub_target_wheat divide = var:sol_sub_base_wheat min = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_substitute_goods_count add = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_sub_size_wheat value = { value = var:sol_sub_multiplier_wheat subtract = 1 multiply = var:sol_sub_external_wheat } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_wheat value = { value = var:sol_sub_external_wheat add = var:sol_sub_size_wheat min = 0 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_abs value = var:sol_sub_size_wheat }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_abs < 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_abs multiply = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_abs > var:sol_substitute_max_size } set_variable = { name = sol_substitute_max_size value = local_var:sol_sub_abs } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_size_wheat = 0 } remove_variable = sol_sub_size_wheat }
	remove_variable = sol_sub_base_wheat
	remove_variable = sol_sub_target_wheat
	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_base_wild_game > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_sub_multiplier_wild_game value = { value = var:sol_sub_target_wild_game divide = var:sol_sub_base_wild_game min = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_substitute_goods_count add = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_sub_size_wild_game value = { value = var:sol_sub_multiplier_wild_game subtract = 1 multiply = var:sol_sub_external_wild_game } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_wild_game value = { value = var:sol_sub_external_wild_game add = var:sol_sub_size_wild_game min = 0 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_abs value = var:sol_sub_size_wild_game }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_abs < 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_abs multiply = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_abs > var:sol_substitute_max_size } set_variable = { name = sol_substitute_max_size value = local_var:sol_sub_abs } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_size_wild_game = 0 } remove_variable = sol_sub_size_wild_game }
	remove_variable = sol_sub_base_wild_game
	remove_variable = sol_sub_target_wild_game
	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_base_wine > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_sub_multiplier_wine value = { value = var:sol_sub_target_wine divide = var:sol_sub_base_wine min = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_substitute_goods_count add = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sol_sub_size_wine value = { value = var:sol_sub_multiplier_wine subtract = 1 multiply = var:sol_sub_external_wine } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_wine value = { value = var:sol_sub_external_wine add = var:sol_sub_size_wine min = 0 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_abs value = var:sol_sub_size_wine }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_abs < 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_abs multiply = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sol_sub_abs > var:sol_substitute_max_size } set_variable = { name = sol_substitute_max_size value = local_var:sol_sub_abs } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_sub_size_wine = 0 } remove_variable = sol_sub_size_wine }
	remove_variable = sol_sub_base_wine
	remove_variable = sol_sub_target_wine
	remove_local_variable = sol_sub_abs
	set_variable = { name = sol_substitute_year value = current_year }
	set_variable = { name = sol_substitute_initialized value = 1 }
	sol_refresh_substitution_hud_goods = yes
	# Disabled substitution retains only the solver's external-demand baseline.
	if = { limit = { sol_substitution_is_on = no }
		sol_clear_country_substitution = yes
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_amber value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_amber_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_beer value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_beer_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_beeswax value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_beeswax_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_books value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_books_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_camels value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_camels_pop_demand min = 0 } }

		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_cloves value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_cloves_pop_demand min = 0 } }

		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_coffee value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_coffee_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_elephants value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_elephants_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_fine_cloth value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_fine_cloth_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_firearms value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_firearms_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_fish value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_fish_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_fruit value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_fruit_pop_demand min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_fur value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_fur_pop_demand min = 0 } }

		set_variable = { name = sol_good_effective_wine value = { value = 1 add = modifier:global_wine_pop_demand min = 0 } }

	# Invalidate country-specific unit totals before the following location solve.
	every_market_present_in_country = { save_scope_as = sol_spending_clear_market remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_owner key = scope:sol_spending_clear_market } }
}
sol_compute_substitute_unit_spending = {
	# Location scope; reuse country-adjusted unit spending within each market.
	# Country/world market refresh invalidates the market-keyed owner map.
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_nobles value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_clergy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_burghers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_laborers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_peasants value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_soldiers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_unit_spending_tribesmen value = 0 }
	owner ?= { save_scope_as = sol_spending_country }
	if = { limit = { exists = market exists = owner }
		market = {
			save_scope_as = sol_location_market
			if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { has_global_variable_map = sol_country_market_spending_owner is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_country_market_spending_owner target = scope:sol_location_market } "global_variable_map(sol_country_market_spending_owner|scope:sol_location_market)" = scope:sol_spending_country } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_tribesmen value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_amber } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_amber } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_amber is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_amber target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_amber|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_amber is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_amber target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_amber|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_beer } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_beer } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beer is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beer target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beer|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_beeswax } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_beeswax } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_laborers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_laborers_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_peasants add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_peasants_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beeswax is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beeswax target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_soldiers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_soldiers_beeswax|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_books } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_books } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_books is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_books target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_books|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_books is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_books target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_books|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_books is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_books target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_burghers add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_burghers_books|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_camels } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_camels } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_camels is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_camels target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_camels|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { scope:sol_spending_country = { has_variable = sol_good_effective_chili } } set_local_variable = { name = sol_sub_effective value = scope:sol_spending_country.var:sol_good_effective_chili } }
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_chili is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_nobles_chili target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_nobles add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_nobles_chili|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_chili is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_clergy_chili target = scope:sol_location_market } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sol_spending_cache_clergy add = { value = "global_variable_map(sol_market_good_spending_clergy_chili|scope:sol_location_market)" multiply = local_var:sol_sub_effective } }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_global_variable_map = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_chili is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = sol_market_good_spending_burghers_chili target = scope:sol_location_market } }
